Condos in Ladner sit in Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove, Port Guichon, East Ladner and Ladner Village.
Most detached lots here are in Delta RS-zones. Large farm parcels exist in East Ladner within the ALR, and the town is covered by Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit rules.

About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Ladner should I look at for condos?

The main condo areas are Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove, Port Guichon, East Ladner and Ladner Village. Building age, lot size and price level change from one area to another, so I pair the neighbourhood with your budget and your commute.
What schools serve Ladner?

Delta School District 37 serves these condos, through Delta Secondary and the Holly, Hawthorne and Neilson Grove elementaries. Because catchments follow the address, ask the district which school applies to a given unit before you buy.
How is transit and commuting from Ladner?
From Ladner Exchange, buses head toward Bridgeport and, on the Canada Line, Richmond-Brighouse. Drivers reach the George Massey crossing quickly via Hwy 17/99.
What zoning rules affect condos in Ladner?
Most detached lots carry Delta RS zoning. In East Ladner you will find large farm parcels sitting in the ALR, and across town Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit rules are relevant.
What should I check before buying a condo in Ladner?

Condos are strata title, so review the depreciation report, the contingency fund, the rental and pet bylaws, and any special levies. I walk through these documents with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Ladner?
Yes. Qualifying buyers may claim BC's First-Time Home Buyers' exemption from property transfer tax, and the federal FHSA is available too. Current thresholds are in my first-time buyer guide.
